_comment: Not loaded: the mod ships no tuning file, so BASE is in force and every number is the one
written at its call site. Copy this into any datapack at data/<pack>/jojoha_tuning/ to change
that. Resolution order is explicit key, then preset, then the code's own value - so a preset
is a starting point and the blocks below override it.
Skin weights are relative, not percentages. Every skin is 1.0 unless named here; doubling one
is the same as halving the rest. Zero removes a skin from the roll entirely.
